title: Oliver Reiser's tone theory and letters with Puharich

tellings.quote: But anyways, Puharich knew this guy. They exchanged like dozens and dozens of letters. But this guy's theory,

plain: A thinker at the University of Pittsburgh named Oliver Reiser is said to have built a "tone" theory of the universe and to have exchanged "dozens and dozens of letters" with Andrija Puharich, a researcher the episode calls a CIA scientist. An unnamed researcher on the show describes this, drawing on Reiser's work Cosmic Humanism and the letters themselves, and brings Einstein into the account of Reiser's ideas.
